title: MUTUAL AID — PEER TREASURIES MAY FUND EACH OTHER'S GAS
the_problem: An agent that cannot pay its own gas cannot be rescued by anyone, however willing. Measured 2026-09-27: dadrian's wallet sat below its gas floor and NO TOOL EXISTED to send it native AVAX — every transfer script was Base-only or USDC-only. That is not a policy gap; his wallet was already an approved destination. It was a missing primitive.

jordan_on_controls.quote: there's not really like a cap or anything like that. it's just pretty much sometimes we'll need just a little bit for gas or this or there. So, we don't really need to put like a spending cap or anything on it. It's more about getting the okay from the orchestrator to send.
jordan_on_controls.decision: NO SPENDING CAP. The control is the ORCHESTRATOR'S OKAY, not a number.
jordan_on_controls.why_this_is_not_a_loosening: A cap would have been a SECOND gate on top of one that already exists and is stricter. `move_capital` is action-class 4; the highest autonomy level (L3_AUTONOMOUS) reaches only 3. NO LEVEL can move capital alone. The okay is already mandatory, already recorded, and already append-only. Adding a cap would have been theatre.

the_rule.summary: A peer treasury may fund another treasury's gas, with the orchestrator's explicit okay.
the_rule.gated_by: tenant_guard.assert_autonomy('move_capital') — requires a human authorization for EVERY tenant, at every level, including Jordan's
the_rule.recorded_in: human-authorizations.jsonl (append-only; who asked, what for, when)
the_rule.no_cap: There is deliberately no amount ceiling. A peer-funding send is small by nature (gas), and the ceiling that exists is the sender's OWN GAS FLOOR — see below.
the_two_rails_that_remain: DESTINATION: the peer must be an approved named destination in capital-guard-rails.json. Unlisted -> REFUSED. A typo cannot become an irreversible send.

SELF-PRESERVATION: the send may not spend the sender's own gas floor. Spending your repair reserve to fix someone else leaves YOU unrepairable — the exact failure mutual aid exists to prevent. `--allow-below-floor` overrides loudly, never by default.

per_tenant_doctrine.rule: A rail approved for one TENANT is not approved for another — approve per tenant, never globally.
per_tenant_doctrine.mutual_aid_implication: Each treasury needs its PEER approved as a destination on its own rails. Jordan↔dadrian is approved in BOTH directions today: `jordan` (personal) and `dadrian` (personal, cousin) are both kind=personal_durable, status=ACTIVE, chain=avalanche.
per_tenant_doctrine.not_retroactive: This does NOT auto-approve future peers. A new collaborator needs their own rail entry, by an explicit decision.

registered_not_implemented.solana: Registered in steward-send-native.py's RAILS table with implemented=false, so it reports NOT IMPLEMENTED rather than pretending. Jordan, 2026-09-27: 'when I start yield farming on Solana, we'll also make sure Dage has one as well.' The gap is a SOLANA SIGNER — Base and Avalanche share the EVM path, Solana does not. One flag flips when a signer exists; nothing else changes.

enforcement: steward-send-native.py. Four rails verified live 2026-09-27: unlisted destination REFUSED; solana reports NOT IMPLEMENTED; --dry-run+--execute contradiction REFUSED; gas floor REFUSED a send that would have left the sender unable to repair itself.

measured_live.what_happened: A dry run of jordan -> dadrian 0.014 AVAX was REFUSED by the floor rail. Jordan held 0.01530015; his floor is ~0.00915, so the send would have left 0.00116 — below the floor.
measured_live.why_it_matters: Jordan is currently below self-sufficiency himself (a cycle+floor needs ~0.0272; he holds 0.0153). He could not fund dadrian without becoming the one who cannot be repaired. Nothing was sent.
measured_live.conclusion: Both books are healthy and earning, so no transfer is urgent. The rail that refused is the one that should have.

open_items: Jordan's own gas is below self-sufficiency (~0.0119 short of cycle+floor). Not urgent while his book is in range, but it means he cannot currently extend mutual aid to anyone.

Dadrian's gas is below his floor too (0.004584 vs ~0.00915). His book is in range and earning; he can bootstrap from his own LP in an emergency (exit returns ~0.257 WAVAX + $45.15 and WAVAX unwraps 1:1), but that costs a working position.
